A Boko shield made of slightly stronger wood and reinforced with animal bones.|Inventory|TotK}} Spiked Boko Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 1 |durability = 10 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spiked Boko Shield}} Spiked Boko Shields are [[Boko Shield]]s that are made using slightly stronger wood and reinforced with [[Animal]] bones. They are commonly used by [[Blue Bokoblin]]s in [[East Necluda]] and the [[Faron Grasslands]]. They belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created by [[Bokoblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} If scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Spiked Boko Shield. Because of their wooden composition, Spiked Boko Shields will burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. However, they float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s like metal [[Shield]]s do. Finally, they are unable to be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_006" |Life = 7 |GuardPower = 10 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 1 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 2 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 2 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 14 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Spiked Boko Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 10 |durability = 7 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} Spiked Boko Shields appear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Spiked Boko Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Spiked Boko Club]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Boko Shield * Bokoblin Gear * Dragonbone Boko Shield * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bokoblin Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
